title: Rusty Pickaxe
body:
"A somewhat unreliable pickaxe."

Description

Rusty Pickaxe is a pickaxe that new players have to buy in order to progress with the tutorial. It's the worst pickaxe in the game, being also sold on the shelf by the entrance of The Oak Depot.

Appearance

Rusty pickaxe is a short sized pick, showing signs of minor damage. It's headpiece is clearly corroded, using the default legacy rust material. It's handle is covered in old bandages acting as an improvised grip, while being made out of typical brown yellowish wood, using the default legacy wood material.

Trivia

  • Initially, player started off with a Wooden Axe and a Rusty Putter. Only after the 1.27.0 update, new players would start with a set of a Rusty Axe and a Rusty Saw, being then directed by the tutorial to buy a Rusty Pickaxe as well.
  • In early pre-release, players could buy a Stone Pickaxe, alongside other "starter" tools. These being: Wooden Chisel, Wooden Saw and Wooden Axe. Only the latter would ever see the release.
